# View(hotel_booking)
#filtering data

hotel_booking_city <- hotel_booking %>%                                                               filter(hotel == "City Hotel")

hotel_booking_resort <- hotel_booking %>%                                                               filter(hotel == "Resort Hotel")

hotel_booking_2 <- select(hotel_booking, 1:7, 15:29)
#peak seasons

hotel_city_adr <- hotel_booking_city %>%
 filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
   group_by(arrival_date_month, arrival_date_year) %>%                                                                
   summarise(avr_adr_city = mean(adr))
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by arrival_date_month and arrival_date_year.
## ℹ Output is grouped by arrival_date_month.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(arrival_date_month, arrival_date_year))` for
##   per-operation grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
hotel_resort_adr <- hotel_booking_resort %>%
 filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
   group_by(arrival_date_month, arrival_date_year) %>%
  
  summarise(avr_adr_resort = mean(adr))
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by arrival_date_month and arrival_date_year.
## ℹ Output is grouped by arrival_date_month.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.

##   per-operation grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
#Visualization for resort adr

hotel_resort_adr <- hotel_resort_adr %>%
mutate(
    arrival_date_month = factor(
      arrival_date_month,
      levels = c(
        "January", "February", "March", "April",
        "May", "June", "July", "August",
        "September", "October", "November", "December"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

hotel_resort_adr %>%
ggplot( 
    aes(x= arrival_date_month, y= avr_adr_resort,
        col = factor(arrival_date_year),
        group = factor(arrival_date_year))
    )+
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()  +
  labs(
    title = "Average ADR at a Resort Hotel by month",
    subtitle = "Grouped by year",
    x = "Months",
    y = "Average ADR",
    col = "Year"
  )+

  theme_minimal() +
  theme( axis.text.x = 
           element_text(angle = 45, 
                        hjust = 1)
)

# Identifying sectors for non-refundable deposits 

# Sorting Resort Hotel bookings 

resort_hb_q3 <- hotel_booking %>%
  filter(hotel == "Resort Hotel") %>%
  mutate(
  lead_time_groups = case_when(
    lead_time <= 14 ~ "Last Minute",
    lead_time <= 90 ~ "Short Term",
    lead_time <= 200 ~ "Medium Term",
    TRUE ~ "Advance Term"
  ),
  risk_group = case_when(
    market_segment == "Online TA" | market_segment == "Offline TA" ~ "External",
    market_segment == "Direct" ~ "Direct",
    market_segment == "Corporate" ~ "Corporate",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  )

resort_risk_table <- resort_hb_q3 %>%
  group_by(risk_group, lead_time_groups) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bookings = n(),
    total_canceled = sum(is_canceled),
    cancellation_rate = (total_canceled / total_bookings) * 100,
    mean_adr = mean(adr)
    
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by risk_group and lead_time_groups.
## ℹ Output is grouped by risk_group.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(risk_group, lead_time_groups))` for per-operation
##   grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
resort_risk_table_sorted <- resort_risk_table %>%
  arrange(desc(cancellation_rate))

# Modelling for Resort Hotel 

library(tidyverse)

library(tidymodels)
## ── Attaching packages ────────────────────────────────────── tidymodels 1.5.0 ──
## ✔ broom        1.0.13     ✔ rsample      1.3.2 
## ✔ dials        1.4.5      ✔ tailor       0.1.0 
## ✔ infer        1.1.0      ✔ tune         2.1.0 
## ✔ modeldata    1.6.0      ✔ workflows    1.3.0 
## ✔ parsnip      1.6.1      ✔ workflowsets 1.1.1 
## ✔ recipes      1.4.0      ✔ yardstick    1.4.0
## ── Conflicts ───────────────────────────────────────── tidymodels_conflicts() ──
## ✖ scales::discard() masks purrr::discard()
## ✖ dplyr::filter()   masks stats::filter()
## ✖ recipes::fixed()  masks stringr::fixed()
## ✖ dplyr::lag()      masks stats::lag()
## ✖ yardstick::spec() masks readr::spec()
## ✖ recipes::step()   masks stats::step()
resort_model <- resort_hb_q3 %>%
  mutate(
    is_canceled = factor(is_canceled, levels = c("1", "0")),
    risk_group = as.factor(risk_group)
  ) %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, risk_group) %>%
  drop_na()

set.seed(123)
resort_split <- initial_split(resort_model, prop = 0.80)
resort_train <- training(resort_split)
resort_test <- testing(resort_split)

resort_recipe <- recipe(is_canceled ~ lead_time_groups + risk_group, data = resort_train) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

resort_mod <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm")

resort_wflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(resort_recipe) %>%
  add_model(resort_mod)

resort_fit <- resort_wflow %>%
  fit(data = resort_train)

tidy(resort_fit)
## # A tibble: 7 × 5
##   term                         estimate std.error statistic  p.value
##   <chr>                           <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)                     0.272    0.0779      3.49 4.77e- 4
## 2 lead_time_groups_Last.Minute    2.12     0.0499     42.5  0       
## 3 lead_time_groups_Medium.Term    0.314    0.0378      8.30 1.04e-16
## 4 lead_time_groups_Short.Term     0.694    0.0379     18.3  6.49e-75
## 5 risk_group_Direct               0.477    0.0810      5.89 3.85e- 9
## 6 risk_group_External            -0.448    0.0724     -6.19 5.90e-10
## 7 risk_group_Other                0.257    0.0753      3.41 6.56e- 4
resort_preds <- predict(resort_fit, resort_test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(resort_test)


resort_preds %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, risk_group, .pred_1) %>%
  head(10)
## # A tibble: 10 × 4
##    is_canceled lead_time_groups risk_group .pred_1
##    <fct>       <chr>            <fct>        <dbl>
##  1 0           Short Term       External     0.373
##  2 0           Short Term       Direct       0.191
##  3 0           Short Term       Other        0.227
##  4 1           Short Term       External     0.373
##  5 0           Short Term       Direct       0.191
##  6 0           Last Minute      External     0.125
##  7 0           Last Minute      External     0.125
##  8 0           Short Term       Direct       0.191
##  9 0           Medium Term      Other        0.301
## 10 1           Medium Term      External     0.466
resort_preds %>%
  roc_auc(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1)
## # A tibble: 1 × 3
##   .metric .estimator .estimate
##   <chr>   <chr>          <dbl>
## 1 roc_auc binary         0.714
resort_preds %>%
  roc_curve(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1) %>%
  autoplot()

library(tidyverse)

library(tidymodels)

city_model <- city_hb_q3 %>%
  mutate(
    is_canceled = factor(is_canceled, levels = c("1", "0")),
    risk_group = as.factor(risk_group)
  ) %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, risk_group) %>%
  drop_na()

set.seed(123)
city_split <- initial_split(city_model, prop = 0.80)
city_train <- training(city_split)
city_test <- testing(city_split)

city_recipe <- recipe(is_canceled ~ lead_time_groups + risk_group, data = resort_train) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

city_mod <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm")

city_wflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(city_recipe) %>%
  add_model(city_mod)

city_fit <- city_wflow %>%
  fit(data = city_train)

tidy(city_fit)
## # A tibble: 7 × 5
##   term                         estimate std.error statistic   p.value
##   <chr>                           <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)                    -0.176    0.0574     -3.06 2.18e-  3
## 2 lead_time_groups_Last.Minute    2.05     0.0332     61.6  0        
## 3 lead_time_groups_Medium.Term    0.620    0.0258     24.0  5.40e-127
## 4 lead_time_groups_Short.Term     0.989    0.0251     39.4  0        
## 5 risk_group_Direct               0.498    0.0651      7.65 2.03e- 14
## 6 risk_group_External            -0.267    0.0540     -4.94 7.68e-  7
## 7 risk_group_Other               -0.635    0.0549    -11.6  5.35e- 31
city_preds <- predict(city_fit, city_test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(city_test)

city_preds %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, risk_group, .pred_1) %>%
  head(10)
## # A tibble: 10 × 4
##    is_canceled lead_time_groups risk_group .pred_1

##  3 0           Short Term       Other        0.456
##  4 0           Short Term       Other        0.456
##  5 0           Last Minute      Other        0.225
##  6 0           Short Term       Other        0.456
##  7 1           Short Term       External     0.367
##  8 0           Short Term       External     0.367
##  9 1           Medium Term      External     0.456
## 10 1           Medium Term      External     0.456
city_preds %>%
  roc_auc(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1)
## # A tibble: 1 × 3
##   .metric .estimator .estimate
##   <chr>   <chr>          <dbl>
## 1 roc_auc binary         0.696
city_preds %>%
  roc_curve(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1) %>%
  autoplot()

#Percentage of cancellations by distribution channel for city hotel 

cancellations_by_channel_city <- hotel_booking_city %>%
  group_by(distribution_channel) %>%
  summarise(
    total_number_bookings_city = n(),
    total_cancelled_city = sum(is_canceled == 1),
    percentage_cancelled_city = mean(is_canceled) * 100
  )
print(cancellations_by_channel_city)

#Graph for cancelled bookings for each distribution channel for city hotel

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(cancellations_by_channel_city,
       aes(x = reorder(distribution_channel, -percentage_cancelled_city),
           y = percentage_cancelled_city,
       fill = distribution_channel)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage_cancelled_city, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Distribution Channel",
    y = "percentage cancelled (%)",
    title = "Percentage of bookings cancelled across each distribution channel for City Hotel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
